about: heist's bed alone (both fighters kit/fighters/base.py's Sound, silent) beyond theme.json: each reference config's RMS per bus (100 ms, dB to 3 decimals) and first-time notes; the variants (a second tempo, a second key, the theme's options), each with its own recording in the cache; the optional hooks the bed class defines, each called directly on an empty mix

notes.line: name midi dur cap vel (floats as float.hex()), one first-time note a line

hook_note: a call's args as given (floats as float.hex()); `buses` the SHA-256 of each bus's float64 samples after the call; a hit's chord of None is the chord at its time
